title: Launch a research, prototype or task agent from a ticket
story: On the Tickets tab, a research, prototype or task ticket now has a 'Launch … agent' button; clicking it opens a new agent tab that starts working the ticket with the matching command. Grilling tickets have no such button. A ticket someone already holds, or whose agent is still running, shows the button greyed out with the reason.

checks.criterion: A research ticket gets a launch button with the catalogue command
checks.steps: Start fresh and open the made-up project 'Sample project 1'. On the Tickets tab open the unassigned research ticket 'Sample ticket 5' (issue 5).
checks.expected: 'Launch research agent' first and highlighted, Take beside it not highlighted, and the line 'Opens a Research tab that runs /grillo-research 5…' with the command shown as a small grey chip.

checks.criterion: Launching starts the agent with the catalogue command
checks.steps: On that ticket click 'Launch research agent'. Repeat on an unassigned prototype ticket and an unassigned task ticket.
checks.expected: A new tab 'Research · Sample ticket 5' opens and types /grillo-research 5; the other two type /grillo-prototype <n> and /grillo-task <n> in their own tabs.

checks.criterion: A held ticket or one whose agent is running cannot be launched again
checks.steps: Go back to Tickets and open 'Sample ticket 5' again. Then open a task ticket you have taken.
checks.expected: The button greyed out with 'Running in the Research · Sample ticket 5 tab.', or with 'Assigned to you. A ticket already held by an agent or a member cannot be launched again.'

checks.criterion: Only research, prototype and task tickets get the button
checks.steps: Open a grilling ticket, then a closed research ticket, then any ticket in an archived project.
checks.expected: No 'Launch …' button on any of them.
